description: Get one rally's details: its settings, description, location, confirmed time if any, and the organizer and participant links. For a Booking Agent, settings also has its weekly hours, how far ahead people can book and how often one attendee can book. Works for every rally type.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the readable times in the result, like America/Chicago. Defaults to the organizer's timezone.

type.description: The rally's type, if known. Saves a lookup.
